overview_description.description:
Bank Muscat is the leading financial services provider in Oman with a strong presence in Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, Investment Banking, Islamic Banking, Treasury, Private Banking and Asset Management. The Bank has the largest network of 138 branches, 431 ATMs, 166 CDMs and more than 9000 PoS terminals.



The international operations consist of a branch each in Riyadh (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), Kuwait and a Representative Office each in Dubai (UAE) and Singapore. bank muscat currently owns 97% stake in Muscat Capital LLC, a brokerage and investment banking entity in Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Retail Banking
product.description: Personal banking services including deposit accounts, savings, payment services, debit cards, branch and ATM access, and everyday banking through digital channels.

product.name: Personal Loans
product.description: Consumer lending for personal financial needs, with repayment terms and pricing determined by customer eligibility and applicable bank policies.

product.name: Sayyarati Auto Loan
product.description: Vehicle financing for eligible customers purchasing new or pre-owned cars, subject to the bank’s credit assessment and applicable terms.

product.name: Credit Cards
product.description: Visa credit cards that provide revolving payment facilities for purchases, online transactions, and international spending, subject to card terms and eligibility.

product.name: Digital Banking
product.description: Online and mobile banking services for managing accounts, making payments, and accessing selected investment and banking services remotely.

product.name: Motor Insurance
product.description: Comprehensive motor insurance arranged through Bank Muscat in partnership with GIG Gulf for vehicle owners seeking insurance coverage.
